_meta.indication: ZEJULA is a PARP inhibitor indicated for the maintenance treatment of adult patients with recurrent epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer who are in a complete or partial response to platinum-based chemotherapy.

pivotal_trials.design: International, multicenter, randomized (2:1), double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of niraparib 300 mg orally daily versus placebo; patients assigned to gBRCAmut or non-gBRCAmut cohorts based on BRACAnalysis testing, with PFS analyzed independently in each cohort.
pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients with platinum-sensitive recurrent epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer who had received at least two prior platinum-containing regimens and were in complete or partial response to their most recent platinum-based regimen.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Progression-free survival (PFS) determined by independent review committee (IRC).
pivotal_trials.n: N=553 (gBRCAmut cohort n=203; non-gBRCAmut cohort n=350)
pivotal_trials.result: PFS improved with niraparib vs placebo in all three prespecified groups: gBRCAmut cohort HR 0.26 (95% CI 0.17, 0.41), p<0.0001 (median 21 vs 5.5 months); non-gBRCAmut HRD+ subgroup HR 0.37 (95% CI 0.24, 0.58), p<0.0001; entire non-gBRCAmut cohort HR 0.45 (95% CI 0.34, 0.61), p<0.0001.

nct_ctgov.title: A Maintenance Study With Niraparib Versus Placebo in Patients With Platinum Sensitive Ovarian Cancer

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥10%) include thrombocytopenia, anemia, neutropenia, leukopenia, nausea, fatigue/asthenia and hypertension. Grade ≥3 thrombocytopenia, anemia and neutropenia occurred in 29%, 25% and 20% of ZEJULA patients. Most serious: MDS/AML, which occurred in 5 of 367 (1.4%) niraparib patients vs 2 of 179 (1.1%) placebo patients.
target_moa: Niraparib is an orally available inhibitor of poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP)-1 and PARP-2, enzymes involved in DNA repair; PARP inhibition results in unrepaired DNA damage, apoptosis and cell death.
modality: Small molecule (orally available new molecular entity)
companion_dx_detail: BRACAnalysis CDx (Myriad) approved via PMA supplement P140020/S009 as a companion diagnostic to identify germline BRCA mutations; the same-day approval expanded its intended use to include niraparib. (The myChoice HRD test was used to determine HRD status as a complementary, not companion, test.)

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee meeting was required.
